description: This is a partial specification of a measurements field, which defines common properties.  Each individual quantity will have its own additional properties specified in-place.

evaluationMethod.description: This field describes how an evaluator arrived at the value adopted for a given quantity.  It will typically be something like 'weightedAverage' or 'bestMeasurement' and ought to be filled in by automated tooling.

evaluationComment.description: Each measurement in measuredValues is marked 'included' or not, and may include a comment.  Based on this information, a comment documenting this information will be automatically generated and stored here.

measurements.description: Evaluated properties will combine the measurement.json schema and any properties they define for themselves and then specify that combination here.
